items.title: Marvell (MRVL) Is Putting $250 Million Into India To Grow AI Chip R and D
items.summary: Marvell Technology announced a US$250 million investment in India. The company plans to double its local headcount and expand sites in Bangalore and Hyderabad. The move is part of a wider build out of AI and semiconductor R&D capabilities globally. Marvell Technology, listed on NasdaqGS:MRVL, is committing fresh capital to India as it looks to grow its position in AI, cloud and data infrastructure.
